recognize_zh: 整個視野布滿大量分支、彎曲的小血管，內皮細胞肥厚、管壁淡粉紅，形成樹枝狀的高內皮小靜脈（arborizing HEV）網絡，血管間是小至中型淋巴球的浸潤，部分細胞胞質淡染，是 AITL 教科書式的血管增生表現。
features: Prominent proliferation of arborizing, branching high endothelial venules with plump endothelial cells
Vessel walls with pale eosinophilic, slightly hyalinized material
Dense intervening infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes with irregular dark nuclei
Some cells with pale to clear cytoplasm clustered around vessels
Nodal architecture effaced without identifiable follicles in this field
describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement of the architecture by a dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells, some with pale to clear cytoplasm, set among a prominent network of arborizing high endothelial venules lined by plump endothelial cells with pale eosinophilic walls. No reactive follicles are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; immunostains for TFH markers and CD21 to highlight expanded perivascular follicular dendritic cell meshworks are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive paracortical expansion also contains HEVs but preserves follicles and sinuses and lacks clonal TFH-phenotype T cells and expanded FDC meshworks.
PTCL-NOS lacks the prominent arborizing vasculature with perivascular CD21-positive meshworks and the TFH immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Kaposi sarcoma or vascular tumor involving node
ddx.vs: Kaposi sarcoma shows spindle cell fascicles with slit-like vascular spaces and HHV-8 LANA positivity rather than lymphoid cells between HEVs.
